facts.label: Passivo no passado (notícias)
facts.sub: Singular: was closed. Plural: were stopped. Negativo: wasn’t / weren’t. Nobody was hurt. Quando: yesterday, this morning, at noon.

facts.label: Foi fechado
facts.sub: Use was closed para um lugar que fechou. The bridge was closed yesterday. Para vários, use were: The roads were closed. Não use a forma base: close.

facts.label: Foi consertado
facts.sub: Use was repaired para algo que alguém consertou. The bridge was repaired this morning. O particípio de repair é repaired. A pessoa que fez não importa muito.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “The road was blocked” is a past passive.
We use the passive when the action is the news.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “The road was blocked” is a past passive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The buses was stopped”. → Falso (Plural: were stopped.)
We use the passive when the action is the news. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: News from a Manchester street · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey Wednesday morning in Manchester. Flo and Lia meet in a street near the old bridge. Yesterday the street was full of cars and noise. Today everything is quiet again. Flo wants to know what happened. Lia heard the news from her neighbour.
“Lia, the bridge was closed yesterday. Did you hear about it?” says Flo. “Yes. I was told that a big truck was stuck under it.” says Lia. “Really? Was anyone hurt?” says Flo.

solo: Aluno responde; você explica o porquê.

answers: Yesterday I ___. → closed
She ___ every day. → blocks
He is ___ now. → repairing
We ___ every day. → break
